title: California foster-care survivor's negligence lawsuit revived after abuse report allegedly ignored in 2006
summary_full: In a significant legal victory, a California man has reinstated his negligence lawsuit against Alameda County, claiming failure in protecting him from abuse within the foster care system. The appeals court's decision to overturn the dismissal signifies the ongoing need for accountability in child welfare, urging scrutiny on the county's supervision practices and highlighting the necessity for enhanced protective measures for children in foster care.
